meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你搭一个只读网页面板:指向任意能以 JSON 列出资源的 CLI,自动按资源生成标签页和表格;并预置 NanoClaw ncl 的面板,含活动图表、日志尾部与只读文件查看。
howto.when: 当你想查看 NanoClaw 的 ncl 资源(如分组、会话等),或想把 docker、kubectl 等 CLI 的输出变成网页面板时使用。

say.text: 帮我装上 clidash 面板
say.note: 会把工具复制到 tools/clidash 并生成配置

say.text: 启动 clidash,然后打开 127.0.0.1:4690 看看
say.note: 本地起服务并确认 ncl 资源已发现

say.text: 在 clidash 配置里再加一个 CLI,比如 docker
say.note: 加 CLI 只改配置,不动源码

howto.what_en: Installs clidash: a read-only web dashboard you point at any CLI that lists resources as JSON. It builds tabs and tables at runtime, and comes pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl with activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to browse NanoClaw's ncl resources (groups, sessions, etc.), or turn CLI output from tools like docker or kubectl into a web dashboard.

say_en.text: Install the clidash dashboard for me
say_en.note: Copies the tool into tools/clidash and creates the config
Runs the server and checks ncl resources are found

say_en.text: Add another CLI to the clidash config, say docker
say_en.note: Adding a CLI is config-only, no source edits
